tileRecord.description: A single record as it appears in a tile's records array. A record is identified by value.origin, or by uri when the value has no origin; a record with neither cannot be told apart from another.

uri.description: The record's own URI, for a record with no origin, such as an at:// URI for a repo record. Records with an origin omit it. It is never the gazetteer's URL for the record.

importance.description: The producer's importance score for this place among the tileset's records; larger values sort first. Scores are comparable across the tilesets one producer builds from one dataset, and meaningless across producers. Not part of the place.

main.description: The top-level JSON envelope of a tile file.

attribution.description: One entry for every collection the tileset carries or references; the same list in every tile of the tileset.
